titulo.alumno: B2 news report: energy in the neighbourhood

intro: Distinguish the collaborative model of energy self-consumption from the technical limits of conventional grids, and analyse the factors of economic viability.

palabras.consejo: An adjective for solar panels that generate electricity.

texto: A Modena, quattro grandi condomini residenziali hanno avviato una comunità energetica rinnovabile: i pannelli fotovoltaici installati sulle coperture comuni producono elettricità condivisa tra famiglie, botteghe di quartiere e una scuola primaria. Nei primi otto mesi di esercizio, secondo i dati diffusi dal gestore tecnico, la produzione solare ha coperto circa un quinto dei consumi complessivi dei partecipanti durante le ore diurne. Il dato, tuttavia, non si traduce automaticamente in una riduzione identica dell'importo in bolletta per ciascun utente, poiché le tariffe contrattuali e le abitudini quotidiane di consumo presentano notevoli discrepanze. La realizzazione dell'impianto ha richiesto importanti adeguamenti strutturali e un finanziamento pubblico a fondo perduto; due edifici d'epoca, invece, non hanno potuto aderire per vincoli paesaggistici posti dalla sovrintendenza. Il Comune intende monitorare costi e benefici per un intero anno prima di estendere la sperimentazione ad altri rioni della città.

pregunta.texto: What is the main purpose behind the creation of the local energy community?

opciones.texto: Producing and sharing self-generated solar electricity among families, shops and a school
opciones.explicacion: A collaborative model of distributed sustainability.

opciones.texto: Disconnecting entirely from the national grid and doing without public lighting
opciones.explicacion: The system complements the conventional grid without replacing it.

opciones.texto: Forcing all owners to pay an identical fixed tariff regardless of their consumption
opciones.explicacion: The project does not alter individual contractual differences.

frase.texto: La produzione solare ha coperto circa un ___ dei consumi complessivi durante il giorno.

opciones.explicacion: An arithmetical fraction (one fifth) certified by the technical meters.
It would correspond to a third, a figure higher than that recorded over the eight months.
It would correspond to a quarter, which does not match the figure in the manager's report.

pregunta.texto: Why does a reduction in consumption not mathematically equal an identical reduction in the bill?

opciones.texto: Because the costs of the contracted tariffs and the consumption times vary from one neighbour to another
opciones.explicacion: The bill depends on tolls, time bands and private contracts.

opciones.texto: Because solar panels only generate clean electricity during stormy nights
opciones.explicacion: A thermodynamic absurdity contrary to how photovoltaic solar power works.

opciones.texto: Because the local authorities confiscated the savings to fund the municipal police
opciones.explicacion: A false insinuation refuted by the management of the energy community.

pregunta.texto: What legal obstacle prevented two historic buildings from joining the solar project?

opciones.texto: The existence of strict landscape restrictions imposed to protect the heritage
opciones.explicacion: «Non hanno potuto aderire per vincoli paesaggistici».

opciones.texto: The flat refusal of the neighbours to have electricity in their living rooms
opciones.explicacion: There was no rejection by the neighbours, but an architectural protection obstacle.

opciones.texto: The absence of roofs or covers on old buildings
opciones.explicacion: Every building has a structural roof, but it is visually protected.

frase.texto: I pannelli solari producono energia pulita

piezas.explicacion: Put the terms of the ecological news item in order.

pregunta.texto: What prudent approach will the council follow before replicating the model in other urban areas?

opciones.texto: Monitoring and evaluating the relationship between installation costs and real benefits over twelve months
opciones.explicacion: A full year's trial period to verify the results.

opciones.texto: Demolishing the protected buildings to replace them with skyscrapers with integrated panels
opciones.explicacion: An urban atrocity contrary to monument protection.

opciones.texto: Banning heating installations in all the municipality's nursery schools
opciones.explicacion: A harmful and absurd decision with no basis in the project.
